newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Gandalf off in heavy trade.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Gandalf off in heavy trade.

text.p: Canadian computer company Gandalf Technologies Inc fell in heavy volume after Gandalf announced it was almost out of money.

Gandalf shares were off 41/64 to 1-17/64 in midday trade. Volume was 2.1 million shares traded, well above the daily average, and Gandalf was among the most-active foreign shares and American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) on Wall Street.

Gandalf said in a statement it had exceeded its available margin amount on its Royal Bank of Canada credit line. The company also said it was mulling several offers for its business that were well below its market value.
Among other active foreign shares and ADRs, Taiwanese integrated-circuit testing company ASE Test Ltd fell 1/8 to 43-1/8. Telefonos de Mexico TMX1.MX rose 5/8 to 46-7/8.
ADRs allow U.S. trade of foreign shares.
